status.notConnected: Connect to the printer to tune the INDX settings.
status.missingVariables: INDX_variables.g was not found in {dir}. The INDX files need to be installed before the settings can be tuned. The plugin is read-only until then.
status.notIdle: The printer is busy. Changes can be saved once it is idle.
status.loadError: Could not read the INDX files: {error}
status.noOverrideFile: There is no INDX_variables_override.g yet. It is created on the first save.

toolbar.pending: no unsaved changes | 1 unsaved change | {n} unsaved changes

row.emptyUses: Empty: the tool uses the general value ({value}).
row.liveState: saved by {file}, not in the override file

overrides.blurb: This is the list of values that make this printer differ from the INDX defaults. "Add setting" offers every other INDX setting; settings tuned under Tuning are changed there.
overrides.empty: The override file sets nothing: every INDX setting has its default value.

save.blurb: The changes below are written to INDX_variables_override.g. The current file is kept as INDX_variables_override.g.bak, then INDX_variables.g runs again so the new values take effect.
save.confirmText: Writes {file}, keeps the old file as {backup} and runs {command}.
save.stepCheck: Check the file has not changed on the printer
save.changedElsewhere: INDX_variables_override.g changed on the printer since it was loaded. The files have been read again; check the changes and save again.
save.done: Saved and reloaded. All values are in effect.
save.verifyFailed: Saved, but some values are not in effect after the reload:
save.verifyUnknown: Saved and reloaded. The values could not be read back to check them.
save.liveState: {old} → {new} (saved by {file}, not in the override file)

docks.blurb: The docks from left to right, read only. The values are set under Tuning: X positions and the dock settings under Dock Position, latch travel under Tool Clamping, Z offsets under Z Offset.
docks.xMissing: Enter the dock X position of T{tool}
docks.mismatch: Your printer has {tools} tools, but INDX_tool_x lists {listed} docks. The dock lists have been updated to {tools} tools; check them and save.
docks.gaps: The dock tools are not numbered T0 to T{last}. The INDX macros need tool numbers that start at 0 without gaps, so the dock lists are not updated.
docks.latchCollision: INDX_latch_tool (T{tool}) has the number of a dock tool. Give it a number above the docks.
docks.noTools: The printer reports no tools yet.
docks.forceTitle: Clamping force at the last pickup ({source})

mesh.summary: {nx} × {ny} = {total} points (at most {max} on this board, {row} in an X row)
mesh.invalid: The mesh area or spacing is not a pair of numbers, so the number of points cannot be worked out.
mesh.spacingTooSmall: The point spacing must be at least {min} mm.
mesh.rangeTooSmall: The mesh {axis} range is too small: max must be at least 1 mm above min.
mesh.tooManyPoints: Too many mesh points: RRF would refuse this mesh. Use a spacing of at least {suggest} mm.
mesh.rowTooLong: Too many points in one X row (at most 41): RRF would refuse this mesh. Use a spacing of at least {suggest} mm.

macros.blurb: Checks that the INDX files are installed and complete: the files of the INDX release, the macro calls between them, the tool macros, and that config.g loads the INDX variables.
macros.stale: Macros for tools the printer does not have (not changed by the plugin):
macros.allGood: All tool macros are in place.
macros.confirmText: These files are written with the standard content:
macros.problems: Some INDX files or tool macros are missing or wrong. See Setup → INDX files.
macros.indxTitle: Called macros the plugin can create
macros.generateText: {file} is written with this content. All code is commented out: edit it for your printer before it does anything.
macros.generated: {file} written. Edit it for your printer: all its code is commented out.
macros.exists: {file} already exists on the printer, so it was not written.
macros.missingFor: {file} is called by {callers} but is missing. Create a skeleton under Setup → INDX files.

files.configMissing: config.g does not run INDX_variables.g, so the INDX settings are not loaded at startup.
files.globalsOk: The INDX settings are loaded on the printer
files.globalsMissing: The INDX settings are not loaded on the printer (no INDX globals). Run INDX_variables.g or restart.
files.brokenNone: Every macro the INDX files call exists.
files.brokenRow: {target} is called by {callers} but does not exist.

measure.confirmText: The printer picks up and parks {tools} one after the other, cold, and logs the clamping force of each pickup in {file}. Watch the printer and keep a hand near the emergency stop.
measure.pickFailed: The pickup of T{tool} did not complete. Check the head before anything else.
measure.parkFailed: T{tool} was not parked. Check the head before anything else.
measure.notHomed: Home X, Y and Z first.
measure.notCalibrated: The load cell is not calibrated (INDX_LC_calibrated).
measure.notEmpty: The head must be empty: park the tool first.
measure.noGlobals: The INDX load-cell globals are missing. Are the INDX macros installed and loaded?

recovery.blurb: For when the printer's idea of the tool on the head does not match reality: after a failed tool change, a crash, a power cut or a tool taken off by hand.
recovery.stateEmpty: the macros think the head is empty
recovery.stateTool: the macros think T{tool} is locked on
recovery.lcUnknown: no reading (load cell not calibrated or no empty-head reference)
recovery.lcRef: compared with the empty-head reference of T{tool}
recovery.lcApprox: compared with the T{tool} reference taken at another position, only approximate
recovery.look: Look at the head before choosing an action.

verdict.emptyOk: The head appears empty, and the state agrees.
verdict.toolOk: A tool appears to be on the head, and the state agrees (T{tool}).
verdict.toolButEmptyState: A tool appears to be on the head, but the state says it is empty.
verdict.emptyButToolState: The head appears empty, but the state says a tool is on it.
verdict.weakTool: T{tool} appears to hang on the head with a weak clamp: {g} g, the park check needs {min} g. Take it off by hand.
verdict.approximate: The reading ({g} g) is too close to call with a reference from another position: check the head yourself.
verdict.unknown: The load cell cannot tell: check the head yourself.

remove.title: Take the tool off by hand
remove.text: Hold a magnet to the tool head and press the button. The latch opens (INDX_OPEN.g) and the state becomes empty. The tool is released the moment the latch opens.
remove.confirm: Hold the magnet to the tool head now: the latch opens and the tool is released. The heater is switched off first.

reset.title: The head is empty, fix the state
reset.text: Only the state changes (INDX_State -1, T-1 P0) and heater faults are cleared (M562); the latch does not move. If the head is in front of a dock, its load-cell reading is also stored as the empty-head value for that dock. Use this only when you can see the head is empty.
reset.confirm: The state is set to empty without moving the latch. Only do this when the head is really empty.

seat.title: Seat a tool
seat.text: Hold the tool on the head and a magnet to the tool head (the latch only moves with the magnet there). The latch closes (INDX_CLOSE.g) and the state becomes that tool, selected with T<n> P0.
seat.confirm: Hold T{tool} on the head and the magnet to the tool head now: the latch closes and T{tool} becomes the tool on the head.

done.remove: The latch is open and the state is empty.
done.reset: The state is set to empty and heater faults are cleared.

recovery.after: Afterwards, home X and Y again: a tool change that went wrong may have cost steps.
recovery.homeConfirm: Runs G28 X Y. Make sure the head can move freely.

clamp.blurb: Finds the latch travel that gives a tool the clamping force wanted.
clamp.noLatchList: INDX_variables.g does not declare INDX_latch_close_tool, so the latch travel cannot be set per tool.
clamp.watch: Watch the printer and keep a hand near the emergency stop.
clamp.noResult: No result yet. Start under Settings.
clamp.used: Added as an unsaved change, and its measured force is now shown on the Dashboard. Save it on the Save page.
clamp.pickFailed: The pickup of T{tool} at {travel} mm did not complete. Check the head before anything else.
clamp.parkFailed: T{tool} was not parked. Check the head before anything else.
clamp.stopped: Stopped. The latch list has been put back.
clamp.maxInDock: Stop at force in the dock
clamp.factorFirst: T{tool} has no dock factor yet (settled pickup force ÷ force in the dock). The close stops at {g} g in the dock, assuming 1.0; the factor is measured at the end of the docking and the result corrected.
clamp.factorKnown: Dock factor for T{tool}: {f} (from the last run). The close stops at {g} g in the dock: the target as pickup force plus 25 %.
stepExplain: The latch closes in small steps in the dock, with a force reading after each step.
It stops at the target, when the force levels off, or at a limit.
Normal pickups then check the result and narrow in on the shortest travel that reaches the target.
clamp.stepConfirm: T{tool} is taken into its dock and the latch closed step by step until {g} g in the dock, until the force levels off, or {mm} mm. Then it is parked and picked up normally, a few times, to find the lowest travel that reaches the target. Watch the printer and keep a hand near the emergency stop.
clamp.stepNoApproach: INDX_TC_PRE did not reach the trigger line of T{tool} (see the console). Nothing else was done.
clamp.stepZero: Opening the latch against its stop…
clamp.settling: Waiting for the clamp force to settle…
clamp.checkTooWeak: The check pickup at {mm} mm left T{tool} clamped with only {g} g once settled, too little for the park check ({min} g). Take the tool off by hand with the magnet (Recovery).
clamp.stepClosing: Closing: {mm} mm, {g} g in the dock…
clamp.checking: Check pickup of T{tool} at {mm} mm…
clamp.noReading: The load cell could not be read.
clamp.missingGlobals: The INDX dock settings or the load-cell scale are missing.
clamp.stopForce: stopped at {g} g in the dock
clamp.noCrossing: The curve did not reach {g} g ({reason}). Raise the stop limits, or lower the target.
clamp.noCheckPassed: No check pickup reached {g} g. The force may be less than the curve shows: run again.
clamp.stepDone: Done: {n} steps in the dock ({s} s per step), {c} check pickup(s). The latch list has been put back.
clamp.stoppedOnHead: Stopped. T{tool} is on the head with the travel it reached: park it with T-1, or see Recovery.
clamp.keyReal: real pickup force, settled (end of the docking, check pickups)
clamp.rSlack: Force starts (150 g in the dock)
clamp.stopPlateau: the force levelled off at {g} g in the dock
clamp.tooWeakToPark: After the close T{tool} is clamped with only {g} g, too little for the park check ({min} g), and the clamp cannot be tightened outside the dock. Take the tool off by hand with the magnet (Recovery).

tuning.stateMismatch: INDX_State and the selected tool disagree. Sort out the head under Recovery first.
tuning.pickFailed: The pickup of T{tool} did not complete. Check the head before anything else.
tuning.parkFailed: T{tool} was not parked. Check the head before anything else.
tuning.stopped: Stopped. Live values have been put back.

dash.headState: The head state does not match the selected tool.
dash.lcNot: The load cell is not calibrated.
dash.lcDefault: The load cell seems to need a calibration.
dash.lcDefaultDetail: Its scale is the INDX default ({v} g/count).
dash.macros: Some INDX files or tool macros are missing or out of date.
dash.dockXNotSetDetail: INDX_tool_x still has the INDX example values.
dash.forceFail: T{tool} clamps with only {g} g, below the {min} g pickup check.
dash.forceWeakDetail: Below {low} g; tune its latch travel.
dash.forceHighDetail: Above {high} g, which wears the latch and loads the dock.
dash.meshOutside: {n} mesh points are outside the print area.
dash.zNotSavedDetail: config-override.g has no matching G10, so they are lost at the next restart.
dash.noM501Detail: Saved Z offsets in config-override.g are not loaded at startup.

patch.cardText: Optional changes to the official INDX files that unlock more of INDX Tuner.
patch.title: Patches for INDX Tuner
patch.warnTitle: These change the official INDX files.
patch.warnText: They add the settings INDX Tuner needs. Every new setting defaults to today's behaviour. An INDX update overwrites the patches; the plugin then offers to apply them again.
patch.incompatibleText: The expected lines were not found exactly once in these files, so nothing is changed.
patch.officialText: The official files already have this; nothing to patch.
patch.confirmRevert: Take the patches out of the INDX files?
patch.c2: A backup of every file goes to a new indx-backup folder in {dir} first.
patch.c3: All new settings default to today's behaviour.
patch.c4: An INDX update overwrites the patches; apply them again afterwards.
patch.c5: Support may ask you to restore the original files: use Revert.
patch.c6: Every changed file is read back, then INDX_variables.g is run again.
patch.checksOk: ✔ Printer idle · ✔ No tool on the head
patch.understand: I understand that this will modify the official files.
patch.applied: {n} patches applied to {files} files and read back. INDX_variables.g has been run. Backup: {backup}
patch.reverted: {n} patches taken out of {files} files and read back. INDX_variables.g has been run. Backup: {backup}
patch.failed: Patching stopped: {error}. The files written so far may be changed; the backup is in {backup}.
patch.readBack: {file} did not read back as written
patch.notIdle: The printer must be idle (no print running).
patch.toolOnHead: The head must be empty (park the tool first).
patch.needs: Needs the "{patch}" patch to the INDX files.
patch.needsAccel: Acceleration needs the "{patch}" patch; only the speed can be tuned.

latch.title: Latch travel per tool and latch feed
latch.text: The latch close travel can be set per tool, and the latch speed is a setting instead of fixed.

prime.title: Prime after a pickup, only while printing
prime.text: Runs INDX_Prime.g after a pickup during a print; an empty template is created when the file is missing.

accel.title: Tool-change acceleration
accel.text: Raises the X/Y acceleration during tool changes and restores it after (adds INDX_TC_ACCEL.g).

settle.title: Load-cell settle time
settle.text: The wait before each load-cell reading is a setting instead of a fixed 300 ms.

overlap.title: Heat during the move to the prime position
overlap.text: The tool can heat while the head moves to the prime position instead of waiting at the dock.

override.title: Settings file
override.text: INDX_variables.g runs INDX_variables_override.g, where INDX Tuner saves its settings.

state.title: Split state file
state.text: Saves the head state in its own small file (indx-head.g), so a tool change writes one line instead of the whole state file. Revert restores the official state file.
state.unlocks: About 0.5 s faster per tool change

lc.title: Load cell
lc.seemsDefault: Seems to need a calibration: the scale is the INDX default ({v} g/count).
lc.after: The tool used for the calibration is still on the head, and Z needs homing with the new scale.
lc.afterPark: Park the tool (or keep it for homing)

zoff.blurb: Measures every tool's Z offset against T0 with the load cell. Offset is measured the configured number of times and an average is used. This can be done with hot or cold tools.
zoff.cleanNote: Note! Crucial that the tools nozzles are clean.
zoff.saveNote: Tool offsets are not in the override file: they are set with G10 and saved to config-override.g with M500 P10 (config.g must run M501).
zoff.how: Picks up T0, then every other tool in turn, and probes each at the homez probe point (X{x} Y{y}). The head is parked afterwards.
zoff.noBed: No bed heater found. Offsets drift while the bed heats.
zoff.bedNotStable: The bed is not at a stable temperature ({c} °C, set {a} °C). Offsets drift while the bed heats.
zoff.confirmText: The printer picks up {tools} in turn and probes the bed {n} times with each. Watch the printer and keep a hand near the emergency stop.
zoff.saveTitle: Set and save the Z offsets
zoff.noT0: T0 is the reference, but the printer has no T0.
zoff.noHeight: The probe height could not be read (sensors.probes[0].lastStopHeight).
zoff.done: Measured. Check the changes, then set and save them.

speed.blurb: Tune each group on its own, in any order: Travel (speed and acceleration), Dock approach, Latch. Steps are 5, 10 or 20 % of the INDX default; drag the two handles beside the table to set the lowest and highest level to test. The other settings stay at the level chosen here, or their current value. Runs at full speed, (INDX_TC_MODE 1.0, restored afterwards).
speed.explain: mm/min, mm/s². A step passes when every INDX check passes (pickup and drop-off, load cell and heat) and the clamping force stays within ±25 % of its median. The ladder stops at the first failure.
speed.noResult: No level has passed yet. Run the ladder first.
speed.checkTitle: Check the chosen levels on all tools
speed.confirmLadder: The printer picks up and parks T{tool} {n} times per step, from {start} up to {end}, and stops at the first step that fails, so how many steps run depends on the result. Watch the printer and keep a hand near the emergency stop.
speed.confirmCheckTitle: Check the level on all tools
speed.confirmCheck: Every tool is picked up and parked twice with all chosen levels. Watch the printer and keep a hand near the emergency stop.
speed.failedAt: {step} failed: {reason} (T{tool}). Live values have been put back.
speed.checkFailed: T{tool} failed: {reason}. Live values have been put back.
speed.ladderDone: Ladder finished: +100 % passed. Live values have been put back.
speed.checkDone: Every tool passed. The level can be used.
speed.used: The speeds are unsaved changes now. Save them on the Save page.
speed.noVars: INDX_variables.g declares none of the speed settings.
speed.linked: Speed and acceleration linked: both change by the same step
speed.useAllNote: Every tool is picked up and parked twice with all chosen levels together. "Use all chosen levels" is possible once every tool has passed; it sets the chosen speeds as unsaved changes.
speed.explainLatch: mm/min. A step passes when every INDX check passes and the clamping force stays within ±25 % of its median and no more than 15 % below the first step: a latch that is too fast stalls and clamps less. The ladder stops at the first failure.

dockpos.blurb: Finds the X position of each dock. Measure gives the absolute position without driving into the dock; Fine-tune checks and corrects it with real dockings. The result becomes an unsaved change of INDX_tool_x.
dockpos.step1: Park the tool on the head, so the head is empty.
dockpos.motorsOff: Switch X and Y motors off
dockpos.motorsOffNote: M18 X Y, Z keeps holding
dockpos.step3: Slide the empty head onto T{tool} in its dock by hand (or use the dock calibration jig). Let the magnets centre it.
dockpos.measureNote: homes Y, then measures the way to the X endstop
dockpos.switch: X endstop: switch. Measuring moves at {f} mm/min.
dockpos.sensorless: X endstop: sensorless (motor stall). Measuring moves at {f} mm/min with {c} % current, taken from homex.g where possible. Measure 3 times: the stall point varies more than a switch.
dockpos.fineNote: Approach: to the trial X at safe Y, then into the dock at reduced current and speed, without locking; look at how the head meets T{tool}, nudge X while docked if needed (the head backs out, moves and slides in again), then Leave. The reduced current is used only while moving into the dock (approach and nudges) and is restored straight after each move. Dock/undock test: from the dock it first backs out to safe Y, restores full current and homes X and Y; then it picks T{tool} up and parks it with the trial X set live; watch the tool, and if it moves sideways when the latch closes, nudge X towards it and test again. X and Y are homed afterwards.
dockpos.lastTest: Last test at {x}: clamping force {g} g.
dockpos.noEndstop: The X endstop is not in the object model.
dockpos.noSafeY: The global safeYmin does not exist (set by the INDX configuration).
dockpos.motorsOffDone: X and Y motors are off. Slide the empty head onto T{tool} in its dock, then press Measure.
dockpos.clearing: Leaving the dock in Y and homing Y…
dockpos.towardsEndstop: Measuring the way to the X endstop…
dockpos.noPosition: The X position could not be read.
dockpos.atDock: At the dock. Look at how the head sits on the tool; a nudge backs out, moves X and slides in again. Then press Leave and home X/Y.
dockpos.leaving: Leaving and homing X and Y…
dockpos.left: Left the dock, X and Y homed.
dockpos.testing: Dock/undock test of T{tool} at X {x}…
dockpos.testOk: Picked up and parked at {x}: clamping force {g} g. X and Y homed.
dockpos.testChecks: Picked up and parked at {x}, but an INDX check failed (clamping force {g} g). X and Y homed.
dockpos.used: X {x} for T{tool} is an unsaved change now. Save it on the Save page.

confirm.measureTitle: Measure the dock X of T{tool}
confirm.measure: The X and Y motors switch on and the head moves out of the dock in Y, homes Y, then drives to the X endstop and homes X. Make sure the head sits on T{tool} in its dock and nothing is in the way.
confirm.approach: The head moves to X {x} at safe Y, then slowly into the dock at reduced current. Keep a hand near the emergency stop.
confirm.test: T{tool} is picked up and parked with its dock X set to {x} for this test, then X and Y are homed. Keep a hand near the emergency stop.

bed.noArea: The axis limits are not known yet.
bed.offset: Nozzle positions use the X/Y offset of this probe (G31): X {x}, Y {y}.
bed.outside: {n} nozzle positions of {probe} are outside the print area: those points would not be probed.
bed.dockRef: Dock Y {y} is shown for reference only (set on Dock Position).
bed.keyMesh: Mesh area, where the nozzle goes
bed.keyPoint: Nozzle position of a mesh point
bed.keyOutside: Nozzle position outside the print area
bed.areaText: Print area (axis limits): X {x0} to {x1}, Y {y0} to {y1}.
bed.meshText: Mesh (probe coordinates): X {x0} to {x1}, Y {y0} to {y1}, spacing {s}.
